description: Fuse and accelerate the sign-DC back-transform / Rayleigh-Ritz GEMM chain for shape 11: after the NS-sign cut (17->10 iters) and the CQR2 fusion, the eigenvector back-transform — lifting the two reduced-block eigenvector sets through the sign-DC subspace bases Q+/Q- (Vfull = Qsub @ Vreduced) plus the Rayleigh-Ritz reduced-block formation Qsub^T A Qsub — is a chain of separate batched GEMMs each round-tripping the n x k intermediates through HBM. Mechanism: fuse the back-transform GEMM with the adjacent Rayleigh-Ritz / finish GEMM (a sibling flagged a finish<->Rayleigh micro-fusion), and push all lifts to 3xTF32 tensor cores with the reduced factor kept resident where the n=512 tile allows. Targets memory round-trips / redundant-work; keep the residual gate + cuSOLVER fallback + orthogonality-edge calibration, route guarded per shape.

t1: fuse the two membership X@Vp,X@Vm into one wide X@[Vp|Vm] (b,n,n)@(b,n,2K) GEMM (guard _SIGN_DC_FUSE_MEMBERSHIP=True). Numerically identical. shape11 76637->77030us (+0.5%, within noise); geomean 27442.68->27455.06 (flat). Profiling grounds the brief: the back-transform (Ustk@gstk 0.44ms) + Rayleigh-Ritz build (AU 0.77 + Bstk 0.56ms) + membership (2x X@V 1.06ms) + AQ (0.32ms) = ~3.15ms of pure GEMM, only ~4% of shape-11's 76.6ms. Pipeline dominated by mega_eigh 29ms + proj_cqr 18.8ms + ns_sign 9.3ms (all siblings' regions). 3xTF32 on these GEMMs is 6.6x MORE expensive (back-transform 0.44->2.90ms) and would regress -- they are already on TF32 tensor cores. 39/39 valid.

t2: drop the explicit 0.5*(B+B^T) reduced-block symmetrization (guard _SIGN_DC_SKIP_BSYM). The mega_eigh_med_split_k AGET accessor reads only the LOWER triangle (mirrors upper), and cuSOLVER-eigh uses UPLO='L' -- so the symmetrization only changed the unread upper triangle + a ~1e-4 TF32 antisym error. Probe: symmetrization = 0.76ms = 37% of stage-4's 2.05ms. SIGNDC_DBG on shape 11: orth_max ~6e-5..1.2e-4 (gate 5.49e-3, ~46-90x margin, UNCHANGED vs parent), eigr_rel_max ~0.0035 (gate 0.0107), nbad=0/640. shape11 76637->76551us; geomean 27442.68->27461.54 (both flat, within noise). The 0.76ms cut is real but ~1% of shape-11's 76.6ms so below benchmark noise. 39/39 valid.

t3: compute eigr in-solver pre-sort, skip the AQ gather (guard _SIGN_DC_INSOLVER_EIGR). eigr = max_j ||A@Q[:,j]-L[j]Q[:,j]||_1 is permutation-invariant (ord=1 = max column abs-sum; sort permutes columns jointly), so computing it on the pre-sort consistent (AQ,Q,L) triple is identical to post-sort. Only Q+L sorted for output -> the second (n,n) AQ gather (~0.39ms of stage-8's 1.57ms, probe) is dropped. SIGNDC_DBG orth_max ~5-9e-5, eigr_rel_max ~0.0035, nbad=0/640 -- IDENTICAL to parent. shape11 76637->76185us (-0.59%); geomean 27442.68->27457.42 (flat, within noise). _sign_dc_solve returns 5-tuple now; large-n path untouched. 39/39 valid.

t4: revert the wide membership-GEMM fusion (_SIGN_DC_FUSE_MEMBERSHIP=False). Direct probe: t1's wide form (cat[Vp,Vm] + X@[Vp|Vm] + split elementwise) = 1.69ms vs original two-baddbmm 1.05ms -- Vp,Vm are non-contiguous batch slices so cat(...,dim=-1) is a 786MB copy, and the split 0.5*(V+/-X@V) materializes intermediates, both outweighing the epilogue fusion the baddbmm already gives. So the baddbmm membership is ALREADY optimally fused. Combined stack now = t2 skip-sym + t3 in-solver-eigr: shape11 76637->75409us (-1.60%, best so far); geomean 27442.68->27426.88 (flat, marginally under parent). 39/39 valid.

t5: baddbmm-fuse the tf32x3_delta finishing-NS step (byte-identical). Q=Q-0.5*bmm(Q,E) -> torch.baddbmm(Q,Q,E,beta=1,alpha=-0.5): subtract fuses into the GEMM epilogue, removing the intermediate + subtract launch per step. Probe byte-identical (max|d|=0), 6.72->6.53ms on the 2-step finish. shape11 76637->75038us (-2.08%, new best); geomean 27442.68->27459.53 (flat, within noise). nsys confirms CUDAFunctor_add 20->18 instances (2 finish subtracts removed). Orth unchanged (byte-exact). 39/39 valid. Cumulative stack: t2 skip-sym + t3 in-solver-eigr + t5 baddbmm-finish.

5 trials on the sign-DC back-transform/Rayleigh-Ritz/membership/finish GEMM chain (shape 11). BEST = t5 (12d06c36b): shape11 76637->~75.0-75.2us (-2.0%, stable over 2 runs); geomean 27442.68->27394-27459 (flat/within-noise, marginally under parent on one run). Stack = t2 skip-sym + t3 in-solver-eigr + t5 baddbmm-finish; t1 reverted at t4.

PER-GEMM BREAKDOWN (probed on live shape-11 tensors, plain TF32): back-transform lift Ustk@gstk = 0.44ms; Rayleigh-Ritz build AU=A@Ustk 0.77ms + Bstk=Ustk^T@AU 0.56ms; membership 2x X@V (baddbmm) 1.05ms; AQ=A@Q 0.32ms. TOTAL pure GEMM ~3.1ms = ~4% of shape-11's 76.6ms. Stage totals (steady-state): 4_lift_build 2.07->1.42, 6_member_topk 2.36 (flat), 7_finish_ns 6.67->6.32, 8_rayleigh 1.66->2.09 (eigr moved into timer; AQ gather removed). Pipeline dominated by mega_eigh 29.3ms (sibling) + proj_cqr 19.0ms (sibling) + ns_sign 9.2ms (sibling); brief-96 region ~12.2ms of 71ms.

KEY FINDINGS: (1) These GEMMs are ALREADY on 3xTF32... no, on plain TF32 tensor cores; 3xTF32 is ~6.6x MORE expensive (back-transform 0.44->2.90ms, build 0.56->3.33ms) and would REGRESS -- the orth gate is held by the finishing NS + membership select + residual gate, not by GEMM precision, so plain TF32 is correct here. (2) Every fusion needing a last-dim cat of the non-contiguous BATCH slices Vp/Vm/Up (786MB copy) LOSES: wide membership X@[Vp|Vm] 1.69 vs 1.05ms (t1, reverted), wide AU A@[Up|Um] 1.54 vs 1.37ms, reassoc P+Up@gp 2.10 vs 1.51ms. The baddbmm membership is already optimally fused (0.5*V add folded into epilogue). (3) Genuine wins REMOVE work: drop the 0.5*(B+B^T) symmetrization (megakernel AGET reads only the lower triangle + cuSOLVER UPLO=L, so it's redundant; 0.76ms, orth UNCHANGED 6e-5); skip the AQ sort-gather via the permutation-invariant eigr computed pre-sort in-solver (0.39ms, byte-identical gate); baddbmm-fuse the finish delta subtract (0.19ms, byte-identical). (4) FINISH precision/count is at its BINDING-GATE optimum: probed plain-tf32 finish -> orth 9.4e-3 > gate 5.49e-3 -> 640/640 fallback (2 and 3 steps both); tf32x3_delta 1-step -> 18/640 fallback. So the 90x orth margin is a RESULT of tf32x3_delta+2steps, NOT slack -- do NOT touch (confirms brief-93). ORTH margin throughout: orth_max ~5-9e-5 (gate 5.49e-3), eigr_rel_max ~0.0035 (gate 0.0107), nbad=0/640, 39/39 valid on every trial. 'stream' absent, -O3.

STILL OPEN (manager to steer): the shape-11 cost is now concentrated ENTIRELY in the three siblings' regions (mega_eigh 29ms, proj_cqr 19ms, ns_sign 9ms = 57ms of 71ms). The back-transform/Rayleigh region has no remaining GEMM headroom -- it is at the tensor-core floor. Directions I did NOT pursue (out of scope / risky): stage-6 topk+gather (0.80ms, the Vall (b,n,2K) gather -- a custom fused select-gather kernel could shave it but touches membership select); the finish's two 3xTF32 Grams (4 bmm) -- a fused custom Gram+delta megakernel could cut launches but is a big build and the precision is razor-calibrated; whether the megakernel could EMIT already-orthonormal eigenvectors (removing the finishing NS entirely) -- that's the sibling's megakernel region.
